question: What flowing nature and musical resonance characterize the honored deity?
premises: The deity sounds with all instruments.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as a flowing presence resonating with all musical instruments.
uncertainties: srutāya may also relate to being heard or renowned
plain_english: Obeisance to the flowing one; obeisance to the one resounding with all instruments.
